root.statement: Close the first real Soltex Home, Monitoring, and Devices slice as a lightweight, truthful, recoverable draft candidate while preserving security, ownership, clean-room, and human-acceptance boundaries.
root.source_state: Soltex had identity, security, update, remote-assist, and Device Fabric policy foundations but no verified immersive local system workspace.
root.target_state: A frozen implementation commit provides real bounded Windows data, honest unavailable states, coherent native WPF surfaces, retained evidence, and a reviewable stacked draft PR.
conditions: Work only in the task-owned worktree.
Do not weaken Windows security or embed third-party remote-control code.
Do not claim human acceptance or unsupported telemetry.
root.boundary: The isolated Soltex branch, its GitHub draft PR, supported unelevated Windows interfaces, and retained Windows CI artifacts; no production deployment or owner-host mutation.

intent.summary: Deliver a visually strong but lightweight Soltex workspace backed by real bounded system state and explicit capability gaps.
intent.unknown_disposition: Owner taste remains a separate acceptance decision and does not expand the implemented scope.

decision.summary: Determine whether implementation commit 2a0699b is sufficiently evidenced for a stacked draft handoff without making production or human-acceptance claims.
decision.unknown_disposition: Keep the PR draft until the owner completes the bounded visual/accessibility review.

acceptance_contract.summary: Require a green Windows build and focused suites, six native renders, honest unsupported states, clean-room provenance, preserved owner work, and explicit nonclaims.
acceptance_contract.unknown_disposition: Human visual acceptance and owner-host provider behavior stay open.

mechanism.summary: One sequential WPF sampling loop consumes bounded immutable snapshots from GetSystemTimes, GlobalMemoryStatusEx, Process, and DriveInfo, maintains copied finite histories, and renders shared Home, Monitoring, and Devices views.
mechanism.unknown_disposition: GPU and network providers are not implemented and remain visibly unavailable.

current_state_history.summary: The exact implementation head, Windows run, artifact digest, test logs, and six screenshot hashes are frozen; earlier layout defects were corrected before the final artifact.
current_state_history.unknown_disposition: The final documentation-only head will be verified separately and will not replace the implementation evidence identity.

people_incentives.summary: The user owns product direction and subjective acceptance; maintainers need reproducible evidence and protected-checkout isolation; future remote targets retain local consent authority.
people_incentives.unknown_disposition: No other human acceptance or production authority is inferred.

lifecycle_recovery.summary: Telemetry degrades through stale to unavailable and recovers on a later success; window shutdown cancels and awaits sampling; branch changes remain reviewable and revertible before merge.
lifecycle_recovery.unknown_disposition: Production installer, activation, rollback, and remote-job recovery remain out of scope.

invariants.statement: Do not discard, overwrite, clean, stash, merge, or build into the protected owner checkout.
Render only observed bounded values and explicit unavailable, partial, stale, or unenrolled states.
Do not weaken Windows security, create exclusions, claim antivirus efficacy, or add hidden or unattended remote control.
Use Zen and RustDesk only within the documented clean-room and external-program boundaries.
Reserve subjective visual acceptance and residual-risk approval for the user.

hard_gates.rationale: The user explicitly authorized Soltex implementation, GitHub commit/push, and handoff work on the isolated branch.
The slice is unelevated, bounded, cancellation-aware, and makes no security-setting or production mutation.
Process paths are never requested, local identifiers are sanitized/bounded, security protections remain intact, and third-party references stay clean-room or external.
Only the authorized review branch and draft PR are mutated; no production, account, device, or remote-session state changes.
No destructive, merge, release, deployment, installer, or production action is in this slice.
The owner has not yet recorded final visual or accessibility acceptance; the PR therefore remains draft.
Runtime degradation/recovery is tested and isolated branch commits can be reverted before merge; no production state requires compensating recovery.
